lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai ras na aavai audhoo haumai piaas na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate a(n)mrit ras paaiaa saache rahe aghaaee ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan budh jit asathir raheeai kit bhojan tripataasai ||
lines.translation: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food brings satisfaction?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh sukh sam kar jaapai satigur te kaal na graasai ||61||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee maataa ||
lines.translation: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gurasabadai jal bal taataa ||
lines.translation: without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his own inner fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bi(n)d na raakhiaa sabad na bhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavan na saadhiaa sach na araadhiaa ||
lines.translation: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa le sam kar rahai ||
lines.translation: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: tau naanak aatam raam kau lahai ||62||
lines.translation: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ra(n)ge raataa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit peeaa saache maataa ||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: apiu peeo aatam sukh dhaaree ||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach araadhiaa guramukh tar taaree ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree ||63||
lines.translation: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man maigal kahaa baseeale kahaa basai ihu pavanaa ||
lines.translation: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa basai s sabad audhoo taa kau chookai man kaa bhavanaa ||
lines.translation: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele taa nij ghar vaasaa ihu man paae ||
lines.translation: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru. Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai aap khaai taa niramal hovai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
lines.translation: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and his wandering mind is restrained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu mool pachhaanai aatam jaanai kiu sas ghar soor samaavai ||
lines.translation: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh haumai vichahu khovai tau naanak sahaj samaavai ||64||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man nihachal hiradai vaseeale guramukh mool pachhaan rahai ||
lines.translation: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naabh pavan ghar aasan baisai guramukh khojat tat lahai ||
lines.translation: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: s sabad nira(n)tar nij ghar aachhai tribhavan jot s sabad lahai ||
lines.translation: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; the Light of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaavai dookh bhookh saache kee saache hee tripataas rahai ||
lines.translation: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, you shall be satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad baanee guramukh jaanee biralo ko arathaavai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those who understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai sach subhaakhai sach rapai ra(n)g kabahoo na jaavai ||65||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will never fade away. ||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ihu hiradaa deh na hotee tau man kaithai rahataa ||
lines.translation: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa pavan kavan ghar sahataa ||
lines.translation: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: roop na hoto rekh na kaaee taa sabad kahaa liv laaee ||
lines.translation: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on the Shabad?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakat bi(n)d kee maRee na hotee mit keemat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure the Lord's value and extent?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: varan bhekh asaroop na jaapee kiu kar jaapas saachaa ||
lines.translation: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee ib tab saacho saachaa ||66||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached. Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradaa deh na hotee audhoo tau man su(n)n rahai bairaagee ||
lines.translation: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in the absolute, detached Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa nij ghar basatau pavan anaraagee ||
lines.translation: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its own home, attuned to the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: roop na rekhiaa jaat na hotee tau akuleen rahatau sabad s saar ||
lines.translation: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence, resided in the unmanifest Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਤਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaun gagan jab tabahi na hotau tribhavan jot aape nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds.
